job.title: Platform Infrastructure Engineer II
job.pay_full: $118,545 – $196,364 a year starting pay (US), with expected On Target Earnings of $130,400 – $216,000 a year including bonus or commission, plus restricted stock units

details.about: Braze is a customer engagement platform headquartered in New York. Its Platform Infrastructure Engineers manage and evolve the foundational infrastructure behind Braze's internal Infrastructure-as-a-Service platform, including Kubernetes clusters, Kafka ecosystems and cloud environments, so every other engineering team can build on it. Braze runs at massive scale: over 3.3 billion monthly active users across its customers, hundreds of billions of data points a month and billions of messages a day, on a stack including Ruby on Rails, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka and Kubernetes.
duties: Build, optimize and manage Kubernetes clusters, Kafka ecosystems and cloud resources such as EC2 and S3
Develop automation frameworks to provision and maintain infrastructure at scale
Implement high-availability, fault-tolerant infrastructure and help set and meet SLOs
Join a PagerDuty rotation for infrastructure incidents; build failover, backup and disaster recovery plans; run root cause analyses
Partner with Platform Software Engineers, document processes and mentor teammates
Automate away manual work in provisioning, scaling and maintenance
needs: 4+ years managing and scaling large-scale infrastructure systems in production
Proven expertise with Kubernetes, Kafka, cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure) and configuration management tools
Proficiency in infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible
Strong understanding of network architecture, security and performance tuning
Familiarity with containerization, service discovery and load balancing
Comfort collaborating asynchronously across global remote teams and documenting your work
details.benefits: Starting pay for US-based candidates $118,545 – $196,364 a year, with expected On Target Earnings (OTE) of $130,400 – $216,000 a year including bonus or commission; the offer depends on location, knowledge, skills and experience. The Total Rewards package includes restricted stock units (RSUs). Benefits include retirement and employee stock purchase plans, flexible paid time off, medical, dental, vision, life and disability cover, fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave, a yearly learning stipend, and volunteer and donation-matching programs.
notes: Hybrid role in New York City
